scope: Read-only installed Auralis window diagnostic after an observed Windows automation skill/runtime update. Does not accept native workflow, import, translation, TTS or playback.
protocol: Reset the official JavaScript session once, initialize @oai/sky, select exactly one returned Auralis window and capture screenshot/text. On capture failure refresh window selection and retry once. Never reuse prior coordinates or send blind keyboard input.
stop_condition: Capture fails again, target is ambiguous, desktop is locked, or an unrelated modal blocks the workspace. Retain the exact failure and continue independent implementation.
native_input_authorized: The owner already closed the game and explicitly allowed application testing; this diagnostic performs no input.
